quotes.text: By the fourth meeting, the First Traveler no longer brought coins either.
the first step requires courage, for trust must begin somewhere.
the rational choice becomes universal caution.
I will not send
I have mapped the way to abundance, but fear holds my feet.
I send nothing. I have learned my lessons well.
This isn't failure of character—it's perfect information processing.
They parted, each with five coins, each justified, each alone.
In a world where partnerships could persist, trust compounds.
Each waited for the other to move first
You are not victim and perpetrator
Yet knowing the path and walking it are different things.
Will you demonstrate this courage you speak of?
occasional confusion need not break their bond.

note: Rain/River trust story turns to wounded figures sending nothing; sage confesses fear, later ones defend universal caution.

quotes.text: the hands remained closed, granting zero embers until justice was restored.
refusing to cast a single ember into a darkened void until justice returned.
seeing the betrayal, the sowers closed their hands, refusing to cast another grain into the void.
they saw the barren silence of the Spire and withheld their golden seeds
Before an untried stranger or a spirit that clung to greed, the wise custodian kept their hand firmly closed
the Guardian shall faithfully return seven and a half to the sower, dividing the abundance equally.
the guardians looked to true intent, forgiving minor ripples in the air.
the sentinel cast all five shards boldly across the divide.

note: Golden Half law (7.5 back); hoarders shunned; R7 onward zero to the greedy until justice returns, by R10 to strangers too.

quotes.text: the traveler shielded their embers beneath heavy cloaks.
Sacred power was never meant to be squandered upon hollow stones.
never cast precious seed into an unproven shore.
Koras released all five seeds into the deep pool without hesitation.
sending seven and a half glowing branches back across the threshold to Koras
the keepers looked with clear eyes to the pure intention beneath.
Without hesitation, Koras poured all five drops into the basin.

note: Koras guards embers in R1; from R2 all five sent, 7.5 returned; R9 adds shielding embers from cold wardens.
